name: Canaga Earthcaller
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller guides new Horde shamans toward the land's spirits and their first totems.

sections.title: Voice of the Land
sections.body: From the red bluffs of the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller guides Darkspear trolls and orcs as they begin the shaman’s path. He teaches them to quiet their minds and listen to Kalimdor’s rumblings. Then they prepare earth sapta to commune with the spirits.

sections.title: The First Totem
sections.body: Canaga sends each novice to gather sacred reagents and travel to the local spirit rock in Durotar. There, they drink earth sapta and see the elemental spirits firsthand. With his guidance, they earn their Earth Totem.

faq.answer: Canaga Earthcaller is a Darkspear troll shaman who mentors young shamans in the Valley of Trials as they take their first steps in the Horde.

faq.q: What does Canaga teach young shamans?
faq.answer: Canaga guides Horde shamans through the Call of Earth ritual chain in Durotar. He brews Earth Sapta so initiates can perceive and speak with the local earth elemental spirit as they seek their first totem.

faq.q: What is the Earth Sapta Canaga prepares?
faq.answer: Earth Sapta is a spiritual draught Canaga brews from regional reagents. Shamans drink it to open their senses to the land’s hidden spirits and speak with elemental manifestations.

faq.q: Why is a troll training shamans in an orcish proving ground?
aliases: why troll in valley of trials
faq.answer: After the Third War, the Darkspear tribe joined closely with Thrall’s Horde and settled alongside the orcs in Durotar. Troll shamans and warriors now train beside young orcs in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Where can Canaga Earthcaller be found?
faq.answer: Canaga sits on rock plateaus overlooking the Valley of Trials’ eastern paths, just south of the main training hub.

angles.text: As a shaman, you meet Canaga as your first spiritual mentor in Durotar. He prepares Earth Sapta so you can commune with the elements and claim your Earth Totem.
As a troll, you find Canaga among the prominent Darkspear figures in the Valley of Trials. He guides young troll shamans as they begin their path with the spirits.
As an orc, you find Canaga working alongside orcish instructors in the valley. He helps young orcs bind their spirits to the harsh soil of their new homeland.
